### Pickle Barrel (G4)

**Who he is.** Pickle Barrel is the excitable **Pegasus colt** from *My Little Pony: Rainbow Roadtrip* (2019), and **Barley Barrel’s twin brother**. They are essentially Hope Hollow’s entire Rainbow Dash fan club: Barley is president; Pickle is assistant president. Their bickering stunt attempts turn into flying lessons from Rainbow Dash, who introduces them together as the **“Junior Wonderbolts”** at the Rainbow Festival—not as actual Wonderbolts. [Special transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/My_Little_Pony%3A_Rainbow_Roadtrip).

**How to spot him.** A light-yellow, blue-eyed foal with a short, swept **aquamarine mane**, small Pegasus wings, and **no cutie mark**. Barley shares his palette but has longer hair and a hat; both get red flight goggles. They initially look gray because Hope Hollow has lost its color, then regain their colors. [Character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Barley_Barrel_and_Pickle_Barrel).

**Name and voice.** His sister calls him **“Pickle”** in the special; the production credits identify **Pickle Barrel**, voiced in English by **David Kaye**. This is **not merely a fan name**. Pinkie Pie had said “pickle barrel” back in the 2012 episode *The Last Roundup*, but a deliberate naming connection has **not been verified**. [Credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits) · [Earlier episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Last_Roundup).

**Other appearances / continuity.** He also appears as a playable character in the *My Little Pony* Gameloft game. A **different G5 character also named Pickle Barrel** appears in later IDW comics; that Earth pony is **not** the Rainbow Roadtrip Pegasus colt or an alter ego of his. [Game entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Pickle_Barrel).
